tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background (cream / near-black). Never pure white for the page.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, table bodies, sitting on surface-page with a line border and hard shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table headers, the console, inset wells.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body and heading text on surfaces. 17:1 on surface-page in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table metadata. At least 7.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every border and every hard shadow. The neobrutalist outline; flips to cream in dark.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative row dividers inside tables and lists only. Never a control border.

tokens.name: brand-rust
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour and Reef (storage). Primary buttons, the mark. Text on it is on-fill-dark (5.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Tide (compute) and informational fills. Text on it is on-fill-light (7.3:1).

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Current (networking). Text on it is on-fill-light (4.9:1). Darkened from #0E8A7E so white text passes.

tokens.name: accent-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlights, selected rows, warnings, Molt (OS and upgrades). Text on it is on-fill-dark (13:1).

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Barnacle (plugins). Text on it is on-fill-dark (6.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-brown
tokens.usage: Cast (clusters). Text on it is on-fill-light (5.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: Spawn (GitOps and deploys). Text on it is on-fill-dark (7.7:1).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Running, healthy, passed: status pills and dots. Text on it is on-fill-dark.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, stopped with error, destructive buttons. Text on it is on-fill-dark (5.8:1).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Degraded, needs attention. Same fill as accent-yellow; always paired with an icon or label.

tokens.name: on-fill-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on rust, yellow, green and red fills, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-fill-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue and teal fills, in both themes.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links and interactive text on surfaces (7.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Underlined.

tokens.name: text-rust
tokens.usage: Rust-coloured text on surfaces, e.g. Reef labels, kickers.

tokens.name: text-teal
tokens.usage: Teal text on surfaces, e.g. Current labels.

tokens.name: text-violet
tokens.usage: Violet text on surfaces, e.g. Barnacle labels (5.8:1 light, 8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: text-brown
tokens.usage: Brown text on surfaces, e.g. Cast labels (5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: text-pink
tokens.usage: Pink text on surfaces, e.g. Spawn labels (6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: Success text on surfaces (status-success is a fill, not text).

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: Error text and validation messages on surfaces.

tokens.name: tint-rust
tokens.usage: Soft rust background for Reef callouts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Soft blue background for Tide callouts and info notes. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tint-teal
tokens.usage: Soft teal background for Current callouts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tint-yellow
tokens.usage: Selected rows, highlighted code lines, warning banners. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tint-violet
tokens.usage: Soft violet background for Barnacle callouts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tint-brown
tokens.usage: Soft brown background for Cast callouts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tint-pink
tokens.usage: Soft pink background for Spawn callouts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline, offset 2px, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; tight table cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical 12, horizontal 20); input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense screens; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between page sections inside the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: App page gutters; website card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website section spacing on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section spacing on desktop; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, the console, full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small buttons, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, panels, product icon tiles. The default.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small buttons. Colour follows the line token (cream in dark).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, menus. The default hard shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, hero panels, the selected card.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state: the element moves 4px right and down into its shadow.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, table outer border, dense UI.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, panels, dialogs. The default.
